bugs_found: fx_convert hardcodes EUR->USD rate to 1 and ignores provided rates, causing incorrect conversions
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float amounts can raise TypeError or produce inconsistent Receipt.amount types
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when min/max fee exceeds the amount because fee is not capped at amount
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate non-integer years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), which can produce incorrect financial results
